choices.en: Here's you pencil.

why.en: Whose pencil? Before a noun, say your: your pencil. You is the person.
why.sl: Čigav svinčnik? Pred samostalnikom rečeš your: your pencil. You je oseba.
why.it: Di chi è la matita? Davanti a un nome si dice your: your pencil. You è la persona.
why.de: Wessen Bleistift? Vor einem Nomen sagt man your: your pencil. You ist die Person.

why.en: Yours stands alone: it's yours. Before a noun: your pencil.
why.sl: Yours stoji sam: it's yours. Pred samostalnikom: your pencil.
why.it: Yours sta da solo: it's yours. Davanti a un nome: your pencil.
